headline: RapWire 24/7 — Five current rap and GTA VI stories
body: Five distinct current stories: Jhené Aiko earns her first Billboard 200 No. 1; Fetty P Franklin and Bandplay release The Frank Play; Kase.O calls for protest rap; Nicki Minaj defends her Trump support; and a Twitch CEO says GTA VI multiplayer could arrive in 2027, a claim Rockstar has not confirmed.
rendered_body_text: Five distinct current stories: Jhené Aiko earns her first Billboard 200 No. 1; Fetty P Franklin and Bandplay release The Frank Play; Kase.O calls for protest rap; Nicki Minaj defends her Trump support; and a Twitch CEO says GTA VI multiplayer could arrive in 2027, a claim Rockstar has not confirmed.
caption:
RAPWIRE 24/7 — NEWS CAROUSEL | SEPTEMBER 23, 2026
1. Jhene Aiko Hits Her First Billboard 200 No. 1 — Westside Whimsy opens at the top — a career first.
Sources: https://www.complex.com/music/a/markelibert/jhene-aiko-westside-whimsy-billboard-200-number-one | https://billboard.com.br/jhene-aiko-westside-whims-billboard-200/
Verified handles: @JheneAiko  @billboardcharts
2. Fetty P Franklin & Bandplay Drop The Frank Play — The Charlotte rapper leans into Southern hustle rap.
Sources: https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/fetty-p-franklin-bandplay-the-frank-play/ | https://www.qobuz.com/fr-fr/album/the-frank-play-fetty-p-franklin-bandplay/eicxh6nggr5v5
Verified handles: @fettypfranklin  @bandplay
3. Kase.O Calls For A Return To Protest Rap — The Spanish veteran discusses Camisa de fuerza and rap’s edge.
Sources: https://los40.com/2026/09/22/kaseo-reivindica-la-protesta-en-el-rap-y-lanza-un-mensaje-a-los-jovenes/ | https://cadenaser.com/nacional/2026/09/18/kaseo-sobre-su-nuevo-album-he-aprovechado-mi-fama-de-loco-para-decir-lo-que-quiero-cadena-ser/
Verified handles: @KaseO_real
4. Nicki Minaj Defends Her Trump Support — In a Fox News interview, she says she “just loves him.”
Sources: https://www.nme.com/news/music/nicki-minaj-addresses-criticism-over-her-support-of-donald-trump-i-just-love-him-3969763 | https://www.foxnews.com/media/nicki-minaj-offers-career-advice-young-americans-delivers-blunt-response-trump-critics.amp
Verified handles: @NICKIMINAJ  @NME
5. GTA VI Multiplayer Could Land In 2027 — Twitch CEO Dan Clancy said “next year” — Rockstar has not confirmed it.
Sources: https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/twitch-ceo-says-gta-6-multiplayer-will-launch-in-2027/ | https://gtaintel.com/news/gta-6-multiplayer-next-year-twitch-ceo-clancy
Verified handles: @RockstarGames  @Twitch

@Rapwire247
